alice_cs: Heads up — Borealis (tenant_id=borealis-9f2) filing: sharp p99 spike on /v1/generate starting ~2026-03-10 09:20 UTC. p95 jumped from ~420ms to ~1.2s, p99 from ~2.4s to ~7.8s. Customer is seeing timeouts in their app. I opened a ticket and forwarded traces.
ben_oncall: ETA on any repro steps? Is this limited to a model or region?
alice_cs: Region: us-west-2. Model: redwood-7b-q4 (hosted). Noticed correlated increase in embed jobs from same tenant pool around the same time.
carla_sre: Can you paste the tenant id and a quick metrics query? I'll check shard queue and KV cache pressure.
alice_cs: tenant=borealis-9f2
alice_cs: quick metrics snapshot (from observability):
```
p95[10m]=1.2s
p99[10m]=7.8s
success_rate=98.2%
queue_depth(srv-7)=112 -> spiking
model_latency_med=380ms -> steady
kv_cache_hit=12%
```
carla_sre: queue_depth=112 on a single serving shard is high. Looks like small-batch embeddings bursting and interleaving with chat gen requests. Could be noisy neighbor from long embed batches.
ben_oncall: Any noisy tenants identified in the past 24h? run query: `curl -s "https://obs.internal/api/tenants/top-burst?minutes=60"` and filter.
carla_sre: Ran that. Top hitters: borealis-9f2 (embeds bulk job), slate-ai (low priority), transient load from test harness. Borealis has overlapping high concurrency embed jobs plus gen traffic.
dan_prod: Customer requests immediate mitigation — they need latency back to normal. Can we put them on a temporary reservation or priority lane while we diagnose?
carla_sre: Yes. Short-term options:
- Add tenant to allowlist/reservations (priority lane) for 2 hours.
- Apply per-tenant throttle on heavy embed route (reduce concurrency for /v1/embeddings).
- Pin their requests to a lower-latency model (redwood-3b) until embed burst finishes.
- Warm KV cache for common prefixes if applicable.
ben_oncall: I'll create the reservation and a temporary embed throttle.
ben_oncall: infra CLI (executed):
```
redwood-cli reservations create --tenant borealis-9f2 --capacity 3 --duration 2h --reason "support: p99 spike"
redwood-cli throttles create --tenant borealis-9f2 --route /v1/embeddings --concurrency 4 --duration 2h
```
infra-bot: reservation created: res-5634 (capacity=3, expires=2026-03-10T11:45:00Z)
infra-bot: throttle applied: throttle-981 (concurrency=4)
carla_sre: I also pushed a routing rule to prefer dedicated pool nodex-d2 for borealis requests (fallback to that pool while reservation active).
carla_sre: For longer-term: recommend they break up bulk embed jobs into smaller chunks, or use batch-embeddings API which respects batching hints. We'll draft guidance.
alice_cs: Customer confirmed they see latency improving within ~2 minutes after reservation. p99 dropped back to ~1.8s and falling.
ben_oncall: Created incident INC-2026-847 and linked ticket #T-4587. Logged actions and commands used.
carla_sre: Follow-ups: 1) schedule 1-hour post-incident review with CS + SRE 2) add alert to detect per-tenant sustained queue_depth > 80 for >5m 3) propose an autoscale knob for embed-heavy tenants.
dan_prod: I'll coordinate the customer follow-up and include recommended changes to their embed pipeline.
alice_cs: Thanks all. Will update ticket with notes and close once customer confirms stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
ben_oncall: ack :white_check_mark:
carla_sre: leaving notes in runbook: "noisy-embeds -> candidate mitigations: reservation, throttle, model-pin, batch-split". Will link PR.
infra-bot: incident INC-2026-847 status: monitoring -> stable
alice_cs: closing loop — customer very appreciative. Marking as monitoring.
